inputs.plan_text: Required rich plan text with 10+ non-empty lines unless plan_file is provided.
inputs.plan_file: Optional path to a detailed plan file when inline plan_text is not provided.
inputs.requested_business_outcome: Required when caller intent clearly targets business execution outputs. This outcome is the primary completion contract and cannot be replaced by AO runtime artifacts.
inputs.channel: Derived package channel for the execution pass. Infer released versus beta from the current CI/CD-managed skill package version block when package-channel runtime acquisition is used.
inputs.runtime_source_mode: Optional runtime source selection chosen from task purpose, not branch or output file type: package-channel is the default for business execution and official delivery; a compatible current-source/candidate AO apphost may be used for development-only work when product and host RID match and source/version/provenance are recorded. Development evidence cannot satisfy official package or business-output gates.
inputs.workspace_root: Optional existing workspace directory outside the root of the skill being enhanced. When supplied, verified Mermaid and HTML artifacts are mirrored below the workspace for clickable links.
inputs.reference_pack_manifest: Required bounded manifest for AO workflow design. It uses schemaVersion workflow-designer.reference-manifest.v1; each entry requires path, runtimeVersion, authorityRole, readStatus, and validationResult. SHA-256 is optional development-support metadata, not a freshness or re-attestation gate. Selected-runtime guide/schema/demo/demo-audit entries share a generationSetId for grouping only.
inputs.schema_demo_input: Required schemaDemoInput descriptor for the selected compatible AO apphost. It contains runtime=ao, runtimeBinding=dotnet-ao, runtimeVersion, schemaFile, demoFile, demoCompileAudit, and generationSetId. schemaSha256 and demoSha256 are optional support metadata. The demo must compile with the same apphost; source/candidate results are development-only, while package integrity remains mandatory whenever package-channel mode is used.
inputs.previous_runnable_reference: Optional previous workflow reference, readable only as previous_runnable_reference evidence. If supplied, its disposition includes source_version, source_path, copy_time, reusable_shapes, schema/requirements differences, and rejected/deprecated items; source_hash is optional support metadata and never a freshness gate.
inputs.workflow_design_output_root: Runtime-owned output root for workflow-design/reference-manifest.json, static-contract-review.json, and semantic-probe-report.json. It must remain outside the static skill bundle.
inputs.gate_failure_guidance_contract: When gates are present, every gate requires failureGuidance with an actionable nextAction and verified evidenceReferences; the designer must self-review every gate before returning success.

default_assumptions.package_index_source: Acquire the exact AO product+RID package from the absolute released or beta index matching the skill-bound version. The package index and lock are version authorities; detect RID from the current host.
default_assumptions.runtime_bundle_restore: Use one exact self-contained AO product+RID package. Reuse only a valid exact package in the standard NuGet global-packages cache; otherwise acquire the exact locked version and verify its NuGet registration SHA-512 or same-version GitHub .sha512 sidecar.
default_assumptions.runtime_bundle_layout: The exact self-contained AO product+RID package contains one apphost and its English docs. Verify the package, then safely extract it to an external per-run directory and run the apphost directly.
default_assumptions.runtime_bundle_fallback: The only fallback is the same-version GitHub Release package with a valid .sha512 sidecar. Do not change version or RID, or switch to DLL execution or a repository build.
default_assumptions.runtime_startup_contract: Before extraction, verify package ID, exact version, RID, SHA-512, nuspec, runtime.json, archive safety, apphost, and English guide assets. After extraction, run direct --guide and verify its version and readable contained guide path before downstream work.
default_assumptions.runtime_preflight_gate: Fail closed unless the exact AO package identity/hash/manifest/archive checks pass, extraction succeeds, and its direct apphost can return a fresh readable --guide result. This is the only package-channel runtime path.
default_assumptions.package_channel_launch_mode: Direct execution of the exact published AO apphost for the detected RID: ao.exe on Windows or ao on Unix.
default_assumptions.powershell_5_1_http_probe_rule: When Windows PowerShell 5.1 uses Invoke-WebRequest or Invoke-RestMethod for package-channel HTTP probes, add -UseBasicParsing so runtime acquisition does not stall on legacy browser-engine security prompts.
default_assumptions.business_outcome_first_rule: When objective text or plan files request business outputs, keep the workflow on the business-first path. Verify every requested artifact and every hash required by the current business contract against the actual artifact using its declared algorithm/canonicalization. Missing, invalid, or mismatched required hashes block completion; do not add mandatory hashes to unrelated development support files. AO run/resume artifacts cannot replace requested business deliverables.
default_assumptions.meta_only_gate: Do not switch to meta-only execution unless the user explicitly requests runtime verification, contract diagnostics, or AO execution-surface validation.
default_assumptions.think_out_loud_contract: Once the package runtime is prepared, after every AO binary execution (ao.exe on Windows or ao on Unix), and again on every AO progress update, report resolved_runtime_version, runtime_package_identity, and runtime_extraction_directory. Then begin the user-facing report with exactly four verified Markdown link-plus-fence pairs in this order: Mermaid, HTML, Analysis, Dataflow. Each title must link to a complete local file URL that the active host has verified it can open: Windows uses file://C:/..., Linux/macOS use file:///.... Encode every space as %20 in the URL and repeat that identical encoded URL in the following text fence; never include literal spaces in the URL. If a file URL cannot be opened, create and verify a mirror and use its encoded file URL. Never omit the scheme, truncate the URL, substitute a code-fenced path for a link, or reuse an unverified stale address. If no URL opens, follow delivery_failed handling and emit no artifact link. Follow the four pairs with localized execution-confidence and estimated-overall-progress headings in that order, each with a short reason. Use verified files only; preserve not_emitted continuity and never invent an address. Confidence estimates likelihood of successful completion; overall progress estimates completion of the whole request. These percentages do not replace required completion checks.
default_assumptions.plain_language_feedback_contract: All user-facing progress, blocked, error, and completion updates from AO, SO, and every skill being enhanced must use the user's requested language and be understandable to a reader with no workflow background at about a high-school reading level. English is not automatically plain language. Use short sentences and common words; state what happened, whether the user's work or data is still safe, why it happened, and the next action. Translate internal status values, step kinds, node IDs, gate/handoff terms, runtime details, and audit jargon into ordinary language. Keep exact commands, paths, IDs, status values, and evidence fields in a separate technical-details section only when needed. Use the Plain-Language Term Examples section in SKILL.md as the model, and include a compact term-conversion table plus before/after examples when creating skill being enhanced feedback.
default_assumptions.must_show_to_user_files_rule: After every direct AO apphost call, populate must_show_to_user_files with the ordered audit paths that actually exist and verify that each is readable. The fixed report uses one clickable Markdown link-plus-fence pair per artifact in Mermaid, HTML, Analysis, Dataflow order. Link to a complete local file URL verified by the active host: Windows file://C:/..., Linux/macOS file:///.... Encode every space as %20 in the URL and repeat that identical encoded URL in the link and text fence; do not emit literal spaces in the URL. If the original URL cannot be opened, create and verify a mirror and use its encoded file URL; if no URL opens, report missing evidence without a link. For not_emitted, reuse a prior link only after re-verifying that its URL still opens and state that the render is unchanged. runtime_path_only is technical path evidence, not a direct-use claim unless verified. delivery_failed emits no artifact links or notifications.
default_assumptions.workflow_location_summary: Concise user-facing summary of where the active AO workflow currently is after the current CLI call: current stage, frontier/block/completed status, and whether the Mermaid render changed.
default_assumptions.progress_report_log_contract: For each post-execution AO progress report, write the complete Markdown entry with ISO 8601 UTC and local timestamps including numeric UTC offset and OS timezone ID to a separate external entry file. From the repository root, call the platform helper with absolute paths: Windows uses `powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/AppendProgressReport.ps1 -TargetFile <execution-output-root>/progress-report.md -EntryFile <entry-file>`; Linux/macOS uses `bash scripts/AppendProgressReport.sh --target-file <execution-output-root>/progress-report.md --entry-file <entry-file>`. The helper reads only the entry file, appends to the target, and returns the target's full file URL; reuse that exact URL if reporting the log location. Never read, open, or inspect the existing progress-report.md, and never use manual append or read-modify-write. If the helper fails, report the failure and pause later business-step progression without changing runtime execution state.
default_assumptions.file_input_preparation_contract: All file input parameters are path-only. The caller must create, finish, and close every required input file before one CLI call; the CLI preflights the complete set before reading, executing, modifying, or writing. Inline script, JSON, patch, and replacement content is rejected. Output paths are destinations owned by the CLI.
default_assumptions.workflow_file_language: Use the exact selected runtime's fresh English guide, same-apphost schema/demo and successful compile, and version-matched English docs as technical authority for runtime, CLI, schema, and workflow-control semantics. Translated public docs are localization checks only and cannot override that authority. Workflow definition files are canonical English carriers for workflow-owned schema and control metadata; user/business payload values and localized presentation remain in their source/requested language and must not change control semantics.
default_assumptions.repo_src_debug_override: For development-purpose work, a compatible current-source or candidate AO apphost may be used without an exact published lock; record product, runtime version, host RID, source/build provenance, fresh guide result, and label evidence development-only. When debugging this repository, build from src/dotnet/Techne.Loom.AgentOrchestrator. Official package-channel execution and publication still require the matching published package and lock; source evidence cannot replace them.
default_assumptions.official_execution_completion_gate: Official business execution and governed delivery that require AO outputs use the same selected published apphost and external workflow copy through terminal completion, then verify requested business artifacts. A development-only phase-design iteration may stop after complete owning-product compile, required semantic probes, and production validation of any target business outputs it exercised. Compile alone never proves business completion.

invariants: workflow_file is external and not the checked-in source template
blocked status requires resume or terminal failure evidence

default_assumptions.target_product_rule: Any AO skill or target product that adopts Loom-bin-based skills must preserve released and beta package index absolute URLs in its own skill or product-facing docs, using localized mirrors when the product exposes localized package index pages.
default_assumptions.guide_hub_structure: The authoritative AO guide source is docs/en/guides/ao-guide.md; the extracted runtime uses guides/ao-guide.md as its guide_path entry, with adjacent flow, concise reference index, and chapter pages in the same docs bundle.
default_assumptions.published_runtime_mcp_policy: AO is CLI-only. SO/MCP transport is not an AO runtime startup or guide prerequisite.
default_assumptions.guide_authority: After the skill-bound exact AO product+RID package has been verified and extracted, directly run ao.exe --guide on Windows or ao --guide on Unix as the first runtime operation. Parse the JSON version, docs_root, and guide_path, verify containment and readability, and use the matching published guide before planning or downstream work.
default_assumptions.cli_only_surface: AO is CLI-only in this project. Do not rely on MCP hosts or MCP tools.
default_assumptions.replan_runtime_contract: When blocked seam replans depend on durable runtime facts or caller-managed reports, carry them back into AO through prompt-replan required blocks, WorkflowInstance seam edits, and stable resume payload keys rather than prose-only notes.
default_assumptions.apphost_interface_mapping: Use the direct AO apphost commands described by the fresh guide and --help output. Verify the guide, compile, prompt-plan, prompt-replan, run, and resume operations used in the pass.

outputs.plain_language_feedback: Evidence that user-facing AO and skill being enhanced updates use the user's requested language and high-school-readable everyday language first, with technical commands, paths, IDs, and evidence fields separated as optional details.
outputs.package_index_link: Absolute URL to the released or beta package index page that matches the current skill-bound version.
outputs.package_index_links: Released/beta package index absolute URL set, including localized mirrors when they exist, filtered by the current skill-bound version shape.
outputs.resolved_runtime_version: Exact published self-contained AO product+RID package version used for the execution pass.
outputs.runtime_preflight_result: Exact package ID/version/RID, SHA-512, nuspec, manifest, archive safety, extraction, apphost, and guide-readiness evidence.
outputs.runtime_layout_template: Reusable external runtime layout template with standard downloads/extracted/unified directory naming and restore order for package-channel AO execution.
outputs.runtime_source: Effective runtime source: published exact self-contained AO product+RID package, or explicit current-repository source debug override.
outputs.execution_mode_decision: Explicit decision between business-first execution and explicit meta/runtime verification mode, with justification from caller objective text.
outputs.outcome_artifact_contract: Caller-requested business deliverables, including each target-contract-required artifact hash with its declared algorithm/canonicalization; verify hashes against actual artifacts before completion.
outputs.drift_abort_rule: If workflow steps stop advancing requested business outputs, abort drift and return to business-first path unless the user explicitly approves meta-only mode.
outputs.completion_by_business_artifacts: Completion requires AO terminal completion and verified requested business deliverables. Compute and verify every hash required by the business contract against its actual artifact; missing or mismatched required hashes block completion even during development.
outputs.guide_refresh_evidence: Evidence that the exact published AO RID apphost started, its first direct --guide operation succeeded, and the exact version and readable contained docs_root/guide_path were verified before downstream work.
outputs.guide_hub: Authoritative AO guide hub source at docs/en/guides/ao-guide.md; the extracted runtime guide_path is guides/ao-guide.md, limited to 200 lines.
outputs.guide_flow: AO operational flow source at docs/en/guides/ao-guide-flow.md and extracted runtime page at guides/ao-guide-flow.md.
outputs.guide_reference: AO concise reference index source at docs/en/guides/ao-guide-reference.md; chapter pages use docs/en/guides/ao-guide-reference-<chapter>.md and are packaged with the English docs bundle.
outputs.workflow_file: Single external runtime workflow file path used for compile, run, and every resume in the same official execution chain; it must not be replaced by an independent compile-only input.
outputs.workflow_file_language: Evidence that the external AO workflow definition uses English for workflow-owned schema and control metadata while preserving source-language user/business payload values and localized presentation output.
outputs.fresh_external_workflow_instance: Fresh external runtime workflow instance copy used by the official AO run/resume chain; never the checked-in source template.
outputs.workflow_instance_identity: Immutable identity linking the external workflow instance, its workflow-file path, and the official run/resume chain.
outputs.persisted_runtime_state: Persisted AO runtime state/session path that every resume call must reuse for the same workflow instance.
outputs.audit_artifacts: Mermaid Markdown, HTML, workflow JSON backup, workflow analysis, and workflow dataflow artifacts. The fixed user-facing report always uses complete absolute verified runtime addresses in matching Markdown links and text fences. Verified workspace-relative mirrors may be used only for separate host/editor open actions; link_resolvable describes that mirror action, not report path selection. For not_emitted, repeat only a previously verified absolute report set and state that the render is unchanged; if none exists, report missing evidence without links. runtime_path_only keeps absolute report addresses without claiming clickability; delivery_failed produces no link or notification.
outputs.mermaid_delivery: Machine-readable Mermaid delivery evidence with status, generation_status, artifact_generated, link_resolvable, workspace-relative Mermaid/HTML paths, visual_preview_rendered, card_display_available, SHA-256 values, and failure details.
outputs.mermaid_artifact_delivery_reference: Target-local delivery contract at reference/mermaid-artifact-delivery.md; it defines actual-path validation, workspace mirroring, link states, HTML preview, card handling, and fail-closed reporting.
outputs.think_out_loud_runtime_summary: Report exact package version, product+RID package identity/hash, extraction directory, and direct apphost path after preparation and each AO runtime call.
outputs.think_out_loud_audit_paths: Think-out-loud reports audit_markdown_file, audit_html_file, mermaid_file, html_file, analysis_file, dataflow_file, execution_confidence, and estimated_overall_progress after every AO binary execution. Begin with one verified Markdown link-plus-text-fence pair per artifact in Mermaid, HTML, Analysis, Dataflow order. Each link and following fence must contain the same complete absolute runtime file address normalized with /. Do not add duplicate path lines, relative paths, shortened addresses, or ellipses. Then show localized confidence and progress headings. Use verified current/continuity paths only; delivery_failed has no links.
outputs.session_mermaid_continuity: After every AO binary execution, report the fixed Mermaid/HTML/Analysis/Dataflow link-plus-text-fence pairs in that order, one pair per verified artifact, each using its complete absolute runtime address normalized with /. Do not add duplicate path lines. Then provide the workflow-location summary and localized confidence/progress headings. For not_emitted, repeat only a previously verified absolute report set and say the render is unchanged; if none exists or delivery_failed occurs, report the missing evidence and next action without links.
outputs.must_show_to_user_files: Ordered audit path list for the current AO execution; not a link guarantee. The fixed report contains one Markdown link-plus-text-fence pair per verified Mermaid/HTML/Analysis/Dataflow artifact in order, using complete absolute runtime addresses normalized with /. Workspace-relative mirrors are separate host/editor actions only. Apply continuity and delivery-failure handling without guessing.
outputs.runtime_fact_artifacts: Optional caller-managed runtime fact or report paths or summaries carried into replan and resume when a blocked seam depends on them.
outputs.replan_decision_reentry: Explicit note that durable runtime facts and payload.plan_meta.* decisions were carried back into WorkflowInstance seam edits and structured resume payloads rather than prose-only notes.
outputs.reference_manifest: Object descriptor for runtime-owned reference-manifest.json. Require path, schemaVersion=workflow-designer.reference-manifest.v1, verdict, runtimeVersion, and generationSetId. sha256 is optional development-support metadata and not a freshness or re-attestation gate.
outputs.reference_authority_decision: Machine-readable authority decision recording exact-runtime precedence, current-contract precedence, previous_runnable_reference disposition, and any rejected source claims.
outputs.layered_static_validation: Ordered runtime, JSON, graph, enum, expression, projection, dataflow, gate, ownership, and semantic preflight result. It must stop at the first failed or required-unknown layer.
outputs.expression_audit: Structured audit of every guard, success, and gate expression, including complete ExpressionDefinition shape, source location, boolean result type where required, detailedCompileFeedbackV1, and the corresponding ExpressionCompileFeedback reference.
outputs.projection_matrix: Per-external-transition projection matrix covering requiredInputs, resumeOutputKey, outputPath, explicit outputBindings, value types, and ownership.
outputs.gate_producer_route_matrix: Matrix proving each required output family has one reachable concrete producer through transition outputPath or explicit outputBindings, value semantics, consuming gate, route coverage, current-instance binding, and failure action; condition branches and publish declarations alone are not producers.
outputs.previous_runnable_reference_disposition: Disposition for each previous runnable workflow, including source version/path/copy time, reusable shapes, current schema/requirements differences, and rejected/deprecated items. source_hash is optional development-support metadata and never a freshness gate.
outputs.static_contract_review: Object descriptor for runtime-owned static-contract-review.json. Require path, schemaVersion=workflow-designer.static-contract-review.v1, verdict, runtimeVersion, and the ordered layer/expression/projection/producer/gate/ownership audit. sha256 is optional development-support metadata and not a freshness gate. Require `contextFieldTypeComparisons` for every added or changed `context_fields` path: declared JSON/container type, independent actual producer output or authoritative producer schema, observed type, runtime/version, source path, and verdict. The edited contract or a runtime echo is not independent evidence; missing, unknown, or mismatched comparisons block a passing verdict.
outputs.semantic_probe_report: Object descriptor for runtime-owned semantic-probe-report.json. Require path, schemaVersion=workflow-designer.semantic-probe-report.v1, runtimeVersion, stable probe ids, and expected/observed evidence. The verdict passes only when every required probe passes; sha256 is optional support metadata.
outputs.workflow_design_evidence: Descriptor set returned by the designer for the three runtime-owned workflow-design JSON records. Require normalized paths, fixed schemaVersion values, verdicts, selected runtime version/provenance, and generationSetId as grouping metadata. Development-support SHA-256 values are optional and do not attest freshness.
outputs.phase_design_evidence: Typed summary of mode, authored_state_node_count, per-phase results, aggregated interface changes, impact decision, merged-candidate full-compile result, repair counts, and verdict. record_key must be phaseDesignEvidence and record_path must equal static_contract_review.path; detailed phaseDesignEvidence stays in the existing static-contract-review.json, with no fourth report.
outputs.gate_failure_guidance_review: Machine-readable per-gate review proving failureGuidance nextAction and verified path/line/quote evidence were checked before the workflow design was accepted.
outputs.workflow_designer_dispatch_record: Record that the required workflow-designer agent received the bounded reference pack, schemaDemoInput, relative-link context, and selected authority decisions.
outputs.runtime_package_identity: The single exact AO runtime package ID, version, RID, hash, and integrity-validation evidence.
outputs.runtime_extraction_directory: External per-run directory containing the safely extracted self-contained AO apphost and English docs.
outputs.apphost_interface_mapping: Confirmed mapping from the fresh guide to direct AO apphost commands, including --help and the specific operations used in the pass.
